title: Sales Qualification, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Sales Qualification agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Sales Qualification ICP list.
steps.expected: 11 fictional records, including size_weight (ICPId size_weight).

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Sales Qualification Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 6 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Sales Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Which bundled synthetic leads should my team review first, and why did they score that way?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Lead Qualification Summary; Top Hot Leads; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Business Development Rep.
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show the BANT evidence and missing qualification details for the strongest synthetic leads.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: BANT Analysis; Strongest Engagement Signals; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Business Development Rep.
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft outreach ideas for the synthetic hot leads, but do not send or schedule any communication.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Personalized Outreach; Draft Sequence Cadence; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Sales Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Recommend synthetic lead routing for manager review without assigning CRM owners.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Recommended Lead Routing; Handoff Package; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Sales Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Draft an SLA and escalation plan for the synthetic leads without activating alerts or automations.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Draft SLA Tracking Plan; Proposed Monitoring; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Account Executive
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Summarize the synthetic qualified pipeline and clearly label every conversion and value assumption.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Qualification Report; Synthetic Conversion Assumptions; Evidence boundary. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Sales Qualification: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 11 fictional records, including size_weight (ICPId size_weight).

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Sales Qualification ICP from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload icp.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set ICPId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Sales Qualification ICP. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 11 fictional records, including size_weight (ICPId size_weight).

steps.title: Create Sales Qualification AE Team from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload ae-team.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AETeamId, Territory, Specialty to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep CurrentCapacityPct, MaxLeads as Number. Name the list Sales Qualification AE Team. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including Mike Rodriguez (AETeamId 1), with Territory West.

steps.title: Create Sales Qualification SLA Rules from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload sla-rules.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set SLARuleId, Escalation, Sequence to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep ResponseHours as Number. Name the list Sales Qualification SLA Rules. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Hot (SLARuleId Hot), with ResponseHours 4.

steps.title: Create Sales Qualification Leads from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload leads.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set LeadId, Company, Titleaaf2320, Industry, Source, Budget, AuthorityLevel, Need, Timeline, EngagementSignals, TechStack to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Employees, Revenue as Number. Name the list Sales Qualification Leads. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 45 fictional records, including Sarah Nguyen (LeadId L001), with Company TechFlow Industries.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Sales Qualification Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Sales Qualification Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the four list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_sales-qualification-operating-rules.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the icp tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Sales Qualification ICP; name the tool Get icp records.
steps.expected: Get icp records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the ae team tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Sales Qualification AE Team; name the tool Get ae team records.
steps.expected: Get ae team records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the sla rules tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Sales Qualification SLA Rules; name the tool Get sla rule records.
steps.expected: Get sla rule records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the leads tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Sales Qualification Leads; name the tool Get lead records.
steps.expected: Get lead records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 6 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 6 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 6 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 6 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: sales-qualification-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Sales Qualification Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Sales Qualification ICP" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Sales Qualification AE Team" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Sales Qualification SLA Rules" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Sales Qualification Leads" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Sales Qualification Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Sales Qualification ICP tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 11 fictional records, including size_weight (ICPId size_weight).
